replacements.name: explicit-lane-flags-local
replacements.text:
CELL_FROM_LANE_FLAGS(clear_lane_flags)->list_flags &=         \
                    ~BOD_FLAG_RENDER_ENABLED;                                 \
                unsigned int clear_flags = *clear_lane_flags;                 \
                clear_flags &=                                                \
                    ~(SUBLOC_FLAG_AI_ENABLED | SUBLOC_FLAG_UNCACHED_BODY);     \
                *clear_lane_flags = clear_flags;                              \
                clear_lane_flags -=                                           \
                    sizeof(cRSubLoc) / sizeof(unsigned int);                   \
                --(run_length);
